name: ElectrifiedMainline
title: Electrified Mainline
author: Bionic Assistant
description: Experimental Electrified Mainline for Factorio 2.1: true 25 kV line, 20 MW per identical parallel substation, source-paid native electric locomotive and +500 kW per motor cargo/fluid wagon. EM077 block traction: one actual hidden native helper per 200 motor wagons per real locomotive heading, plus one remainder helper. Keeps the EM076 no-traction-power warning and hidden-helper icon suppression. Research build; not a stable release. Regeneration, owner Windows GUI acceptance, save migration and multiplayer remain under testing. EM078 experimental UI: suppress native no-path alert icons and Alt-mode fuel indicators only on 256 hidden technical locomotives; real EM route alerts remain. EM079: V3 visual-only locomotive trial; no gameplay changes. EM080: native V3 bogies and folded collector in placement preview; cosmetic only. EM081: local V3 wheel rerender, joint-centered atlas; no gameplay changes. EM082: native wheel visibility correction; same exact EM081 artwork. EM084: motor-wagon GUI status uses traction terminology rather than fuel; cargo/fluid entity localizations fixed. EM085: obsolete ordinary mod electric pole removed from prototypes and interface, JSON-migrated to vanilla small electric poles in old saves.
